hypothesis: In decode the Metal chain's GPU experts wait on SSD reads for about half of a step; running the next layer's router on the current MLP row and announcing its six likeliest uncached experts to the OS (F_RDADVISE on their GGUF ranges) once the next trunk is submitted lets the SSD read them while the GPU computes, so decode after the 61-token short.txt prompt gets faster with the same tokens.
model: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next heretic-2, llama.cpp IQ4_XS GGUF (routed experts IQ4_XS gate/up, IQ4_NL down, 2.54 MiB each; trunk mostly Q8_0), imported in link mode (colibri-dev)
command: BUILD='cecdd723 METAL=1' METAL=1 WARMUP=1 BENCH_RAW=results/raw-m3 ARM_ENV='USAGE_SAVE=0 QWEN38_METAL_AHEAD=<0|1>' bench/q38_bench.sh bench/bin/qwen38-metal-m3 ~/models/qwen38-heretic2/colibri-dev metal-m3-<noahead|ahead> 3

hardware.cpu: Apple M4 Pro, 8 performance + 4 efficiency cores (Mac16,8)

config.SNAP: qwen38-heretic2 colibri-dev (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next heretic-2 IQ4_XS GGUF, 5 files, 117 GB, read in place)
config.BUILD: make -C c qwen38 METAL=1 at cecdd723 (rm c/qwen38 first), copied to bench/bin/qwen38-metal-m3, one binary for both arms
config.ENGINE: the Metal chain, default (fast) kernels, GPU experts on (M3), the default GPU expert cache (6.82 GiB, 2751 slots of 2,662,400 B)
config.ENV: SNAP COLI_TEMP=0 Q38_MAXT=32768 USAGE_SAVE=0, OMP_NUM_THREADS unset; argv 32 8 <prompt>
config.PROMPT: bench/prompts/short.txt (61 tokens, chat template), 64 greedy tokens
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run (discarded) then 3 decode runs and 3 long12k prefill runs per arm, noahead arm first, then ahead; one process each
config.MEASURED: decode tok/s = 63 / (decode seconds - TTFT) of each short.txt run

quality.method: the generated text and the run's report (loads 19,655, hits 18,531 on every decode run; loads 504,053, hits 115,555 on every prefill run) identical in all 14 runs of both arms; tiny fixtures: bit-identical logits on/off (test-qwen38-metal-engine, ahead tokens)
